preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address (owner, MarketingWallet, or Developer)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the UpdateTaxes function to set buyTax to a value higher than the MaxTax constant (20). For example, set buyTax to 25 or higher, which violates the intended reasonable percent limit. This demonstrates the owner can manipulate fees beyond reasonable bounds.
